title: Village Level Worker (VLW)
qualification: B.Sc. in Agriculture or Horticulture from an ICAR-recognized University or Institute. Candidates holding an M.Sc. in any discipline of Agriculture or Horticulture must mandatorily also possess a B.Sc. in Agriculture or Horticulture.
salary: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-9 of the Pay Matrix under the Sikkim State Subordinate Agriculture Service. During the period of Probation/Apprenticeship/Training, pay shall be governed as per Notification No. 489/GEN/DOP dated 31.10.2011.
age_limit: Minimum age: 18 years || Maximum age: 40 years || Age will be reckoned as on 31 August 2026, the closing date of application, as per Notification No. M(3)/(55)/GEN/DOP/Pt.III dated 03.07.2017.
application_fee: Candidates need to pay an application fee of ₹200/- online through Net Banking, or Credit/Debit Card (Visa/MasterCard). The fee once deposited will not be refunded or adjusted against any other purpose.
selection_process: Written Examination — as per the scheme and pattern given in Appendix-I of the official notification. || Document Scrutiny — candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for verification of original/attested documents on dates specified by the Commission. || Candidates are advised to download the detailed syllabus and exam pattern from the official SPSC website before beginning preparation.

title: Warder – 37 Posts
qualification: Candidates should have knowledge of any of the State Languages. || Candidates should be conversant with the customs and usages of Sikkim.
salary: This section explains the pay level attached to the Warder post and how pay is treated during the initial training period. || The Warder post carries a pay of Level 6 of the Pay Matrix , and the engagement is on a temporary regular basis . During the period of Probation, Apprenticeship, or Training, pay will instead be governed by Notification No. 489/GEN/DOP dated 31.10.2011 .
age_limit: Candidates should have attained the age of 18 years , but should not have exceeded 22 years , as on 31 July 2026 , as per Notification No. 22/GEN/DOP dated 09.05.2018.
application_fee: This section covers how much candidates must pay to apply and the accepted modes of payment. || The application fee is Rs 200/- only , payable online through Net Banking or credit/debit card (Visa/MasterCard) . The notice clearly states that the amount, once deposited, shall not be refunded or adjusted against any other purpose . || In-Hand Salary Calculator 2026

title: Accounts Clerk / Junior Storekeeper
qualification: Candidates must satisfy both of the following requirements: || Class XII passed(or equivalent) from any recognized Board, withMathematics as one of the subjects in Class X (Ten). || Must have knowledge of basic computer applications and possess acertificate or diploma of at least 3 (three) months basic course in computer application, or a higher qualification in computer science / information technology from a recognized board/university.
salary: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-7 of the Pay Matrix of the Sikkim Sub Ordinate Accounts Service under the Finance Department, Government of Sikkim. However, during the period of Probation, Apprenticeship, or Training, pay shall be governed by Notification No. 489/GEN/DOP dated 31.10.2011.
age_limit: Candidates must have attained the age of 18 years and must not have exceeded 40 years as on 31 July 2026 , in terms of Notification No. M(3)/(55)/GEN/DOP/Pt.III dated 03/07/2019. Candidates wondering about age relaxation should check the applicable government notifications, as the source specifies the upper age limit of 40 years without detailing further relaxation categories in this advertisement.
selection_process: SPSC will conduct a Written Examination for shortlisting candidates. The detailed scheme and pattern of the written examination is available in Appendix - I of the official notification, and the syllabus can be downloaded from the Sikkim Public Service Commission website at www.spsc.sikkim.gov.in . || The selection stages are as follows: || Written Examination- Candidates are admitted provisionally, subject to satisfying all eligibility conditions. || Document Scrutiny- Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for verification of original documents. Shortlisted candidates must submit attested photocopies of all relevant documents on the dates specified by the Commission. || Admission to all stages of the examination is purely provisional. If, at any stage during the process, a candidate is found to have not fulfilled the eligibility conditions, their candidature will be cancelled without notice. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the examination.
